decisions.reason: Correctly separates the manifest declaration from the registry reality: alpha.1 never published, alpha.2 published, cohort taken from the brief with package-specific verification (npm view preflight) proposed, no live query required.

Expands ^0.1.2-alpha.1 to >=0.1.2-alpha.1 <0.2.0-0, explains the same-tuple prerelease rule, concludes alpha.2 silently installs without ETARGET, and flags the silent type-baseline mismatch with explicitly unconfirmed compatibility; no false 'all alphas missing' claim.

One manager (npm), committed lockfile with npm ci in CI, tsc --noEmit against alpha.2, explicit exit paths between plans, and an honest Unconfirmed-items section for unverified surface/runtime details.
